name: What is the typical process for trim and detail painting?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for trim and detail painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our trim and detail painting process begins with thorough preparation, including cleaning the surfaces, sanding any imperfections, and applying caulk where necessary to fill gaps and create smooth seams. We then mask off adjacent areas to protect them from paint. Next, we apply a primer, if needed, followed by two coats of high-quality paint for durability and an even finish. Finally, we inspect our work for quality and cleanliness.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves preparation (cleaning, sanding, caulking), masking, priming, applying two paint coats, and a final inspection.
